changes.description: named runs as the bind user (uid 53) from the start, without any capability: the net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start sysctl lets it bind port 53 in the pod. The pods meet the restricted Pod Security Standard.

nodeSelector defaults to kubernetes.io/arch: amd64, the only architecture of the ISC image, for the pods and the helm test pod (no more exec format error on arm64 nodes).

End-to-end test in CI, in a namespace that enforces the restricted Pod Security Standard: the zones answer their records over UDP and TCP from another pod, transfers and other zones are refused, the exporter reports bind_up 1, and the NetworkPolicy keeps the metrics from other pods.

changes.description: The recursor webserver (API, /metrics) moves from the recursor DNS Service to its own ClusterIP Service, <fullname>-recursor-api: a LoadBalancer recursor Service no longer publishes it.

gmysql schema init: the MySQL client options file, which holds the password, is written to a memory-backed /tmp private to the init container instead of the disk-backed /tmp shared with the server; the password is escaped, so quotes and backslashes no longer break it.

The Secret holding a generated API key is kept on uninstall (helm.sh/resource-policy: keep), so that a reinstall reuses the key; the schema init container only gets the database password and the helm test pod only the API key.
The schema init container mounts extraVolumeMounts, so a CA given in backend.gpgsql.extraConnectionParameters (sslrootcert) works with the schema init enabled.

gmysql with the UnxWares image: the server connects to a MySQL server with a self-signed certificate (the default of MySQL), encrypted without checking the certificate like the MySQL client; backend.gmysql.verifyServerCertificate: true keeps the check.
An IPv6 address of the authoritative Service (service.clusterIP or the injected variable) is written in brackets in the recursor forwarders.

Schema init images: ghcr.io/unxwares/postgresql-client:18 and ghcr.io/unxwares/mysql-client:8.4 with imageProvider: unxwares (the clients alone), docker.io/library/postgres:18.6-alpine and docker.io/library/mysql:8.4.13 with upstream. backend.schemaInit.mysqlImage defaults to empty.
The NOTES show the images actually deployed (tag or digest); autoscaling.targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage is a documented value.

End-to-end test in CI on SQLite with the recursor, PostgreSQL over verified TLS and MySQL, in a namespace that enforces the restricted Pod Security Standard: the API refuses wrong keys and manages zones, the records are answered by the authoritative server and the recursor, and survive a restart.
